title: About the Album: Storm Before the Storm
subtitle: The Story Behind Each Song
author: Rafi Barides
description: A deeply personal look into the stories behind each song on Storm Before the Storm. From heartbreak and identity struggles to family tension and rock bottom—this is what the album is really about.

title: Why I Sing Even Though I Was Told I Never Should
subtitle: I Spent My Life Hating My Voice. This Is What Changed.
author: Rafi Barides
description: After years of being told I'd never be a singer, I share my journey from hating my voice to releasing an album. Learn how I transformed my vocals through persistence, breathing techniques, and embracing my unique sound.

title: The Other Half of My Music
subtitle: How Photography Became the Visual Language for My Sound
author: Rafi Barides
description: From borrowing a Nikon D3200 in yeshivah to becoming a Getty Images contributor, photography evolved into the visual companion to my music. Discover how self-portraits and image-making help me translate sound into emotion.

title: Storm Before the Storm
subtitle: How I Got Here
author: Rafi Barides
description: A personal reflection on purpose, identity, and the journey from an Orthodox Jewish upbringing to building a creative life. From yeshiva to GED, from releasing an album to learning engineering—this is the story of finding alignment through chaos.

title: My Story of Something From Nothing
subtitle: Why Being a Generalist Isn't a Weakness
author: Rafi Barides
description: From directing music videos with millions of views to building VST plugins, iOS apps, and sample packs—this is my case for why range across disciplines isn't scattered. It's leverage.
